item.title: WRE News: Miami Beach Approves $500 Surplus Checks for Homeowners
item.description: Miami, FL - December 19, 2025 - Miami Beach city commissioners voted unanimously to distribute $500 payments to more than 14,000 homesteaded homeowners using surplus budget funds, approving up to $7 million in relief tied to primary residences. While details on timing and distribution are still pending, supporters framed the move as a way to return excess taxpayer money directly to residents, marking the city’s first surplus payout in nearly two decades.
